definitions.explanation: A formal discussion or argument on a particular topic, especially one in which opposing views are put forward.

examples.japanese: {討論|とうろん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦について→について：03103_nitsuite⟧{討論|とうろん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{討論|とうろん}{会|かい}→討論会：25422_touronkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A televised debate was held before the election.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦たち→〜たち：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦について→について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{熱心|ねっしん}→熱心：01207_nesshin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{討論|とうろん}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The students were passionately debating environmental issues.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦について→について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{何時間|なんじかん}→何時間：noentry⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{討論|とうろん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いたが→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出|で}なかった→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: In the Diet, debate on the new bill continued for hours, but no conclusion was reached.

notes:
{討論|とうろん} refers to a formal debate where opposing views are presented and examined. Composed of {討|とう} (attack/discuss) + {論|ろん} (argument).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {討論|とうろん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to debate
- ⟦{討論|とうろん}{会|かい}→討論会：25422_touronkai⟧: debate meeting, panel discussion
- {討論|とうろん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold a debate
- ⟦{活発|かっぱつ}→活発：13272_kappatsu⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{討論|とうろん}: lively debate
- ⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧{討論|とうろん}: public debate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧: discussion, argument (broader — can be informal or heated)
- ⟦ディベート→ディベート：30371_dibeeto⟧: debate (loanword, often used for formal competitive debate)
- ⟦{論争|ろんそう}→論争：03786_ronsou⟧: controversy, dispute (implies ongoing disagreement)
- ⟦{審議|しんぎ}→審議：19112_shingi⟧: deliberation (formal, legislative)

REGISTER:
A written and formal-spoken word, at home in politics, journalism, and academic settings. In everyday conversation about disagreements, speakers reach for ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧ or ⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}い→話し合い：14176_hanashiai⟧ instead; {討論|とうろん} implies a structured exchange with sides.
